channel.title: AI GridWatch — Tennessee data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Tennessee, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Anderson County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year moratorium (unanimous); commission will develop regulations during pause period

item.title: Knox County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium passed unanimously 10-0 by county commission. Planning commission developing zoning recommendations

item.title: Knoxville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on large data centers (10+ MW peak demand). Pauses permits, building approvals, utility extensions, and development agreements. Expires Jul 7, 2027 or when zoning amendments take effect, whichever is first

item.title: Johnson City: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium extended unanimously to Dec 3, 2026 while a special board drafts noise and distance regulations. Data centers limited to I-2 Heavy Industrial zone since 2025. 5,000+ of 6,000 survey respondents 'extremely concerned'

item.title: McMinnville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 18-month moratorium, unanimous; prompted by a proposed 25 MW Nvidia GB200 NVL72 AI campus. 2,600+ petition signatures. Town halls scheduled Jun 25 and 29

item.title: Nashville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Metro Council passed the city's first data center regulations plus a permit moratorium; an amendment holds the pause to Dec 1 whether or not the regulations pass
